[劳埃德]
很快我就需要每天让你为我服务了。
别担心，就当是为团队出一份力吧。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
You know the drill: collect condensed energy.
You'll do that for me, won't you?
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
你知道该怎么做：收集浓缩能量。
你会为我做的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
All you have to do is collect energy that naturally gathers around the remnants of robots and machines.
I need 10 bottles every day.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
你只需要收集自然聚集在机器人和机器残骸周围的能量。
我每天需要10瓶。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
I think I like you!
Not as much as Aures and Luke, though.
All right, I'll make good use of this energy.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
我觉得我挺喜欢你的！
虽然比不上奥雷斯和卢克。
好吧，我会好好利用这些能量的。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
I'm analyzing the collected energy.
...
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
我正在分析收集到的能量。
...

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Hm, maybe I need to find a special storage method.
The energy dissipates so easily.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
嗯，也许我需要找到一种特殊的储存方法。
这种能量消散得太快了。

scripts.text: [Lloyd]
scripts.translation: [劳埃德]

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Just keep your distance and mind your own business.
You and I will be fine so long as you don't steal my hard work.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
保持距离，管好你自己的事。
只要你别偷走我辛苦的成果，我们就能相安无事。

scripts.text: Are you Lloyd?
scripts.translation: 你是劳埃德吗？

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Yeah. What's up?
Huh? Aures sent you?
To check up on my progress?
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
是啊。怎么了？
啊？是奥雷斯派你来的？
来检查我的研究进度？

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Oh, I'm in trouble.
I must live up to his expectations,
but my research has been stagnant.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
哦，这下麻烦了。
我必须不辜负他的期望，
但我的研究一直停滞不前。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Hey, could you help
me with something?
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
嘿，你能帮
我个忙吗？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text: What is a Cat doing here?
scripts.translation: 一只猫在这里做什么？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Unlike many from Malangdo Island, I've always been interested in new technologies and cultures.
I worked at companies, and I've learned alchemy.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
与绵绵岛的许多人不同，我一直对新科技和文化很感兴趣。
我在公司工作过，也学过融合试验。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
I came to Verus City when I heard the news of its discovery. I was told that I must be in an excavation team to be in the city.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
当我听说这里被发现的新闻时，我就来到了维鲁斯城。听说必须加入挖掘队才能进入城中。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Aures helped me to get in.
I'm also a member of the Atnad Excavation Team.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
是奥雷斯帮我进来的。
我也是阿特纳德挖掘队的一员。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
Sorry to interrupt,
but you're from the Eden Group to help the excavation team.
scripts.translation:
[卢克]
抱歉打断一下，
你是乐园团派来协助挖掘队的。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
Your job is to help Lloyd.
You can't say no.
scripts.translation:
[卢克]
你的任务是协助劳埃德。
你不能拒绝。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
He's right!
You're obligated to help me with my research!
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
他说得对！
你有义务协助我的研究！

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Let's cut to the chase.
Hey, Human help.
Get 10 empty glass bottles,
and collect condensed energy found around the remnants of robots.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
我们直入正题吧。
嘿，人类帮手。
去弄10个空瓶，
然后收集机器人残骸周围发现的浓缩能量。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
This place is littered with broken robots and machines.
Clouds of physical energy are discovered near them.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
这地方到处都是破碎的机器人和机器。
在它们附近可以发现物理能量云。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Just bring empty bottles close to the energy, and it'll enter the bottles.
Bring me 10 bottles.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
只需将空瓶靠近能量，它就会进入瓶中。
给我带10瓶来。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
I'll be waiting.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
我会等着的。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Just bring empty bottles close to the energy, and it'll enter the bottles.
Bring me 10 bottles.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
只需将空瓶靠近能量，它就会进入瓶中。
给我带10瓶来。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
You must be dumber than you look if you have to ask twice.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
如果你需要问两遍，那你肯定比看起来更笨。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
You've made my job easier.
Finally, I can be useful to Aures.
If I find the cause of the condensation of energy and its possible applications, maybe
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
你让我的工作变得轻松多了。
终于，我能为奥雷斯派上用场了。
如果我找到能量凝结的原因及其可能的应用，也许

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Ian and I can reactivate the robots in this place.
That's what we've wanted all along.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
我和伊恩可以重新激活这里的机器人。
这正是我们一直想要的。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Tell Aures I'm making progress.
Good job, Human.
I'll look forward to using your service again.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
告诉奥雷斯，我正在取得进展。
干得好，人类。
期待再次使用你的服务。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text: Decline.
scripts.translation: 拒绝

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Why, do you have something else to do?
All right then,
I'll ask Luke to take me around.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
怎么，你还有别的事要做？
那好吧，
我会请卢克带我四处看看。

scripts.text:
[Luke]
I thought you'd never ask!
I've been itching for some action.
scripts.translation:
[卢克]
我还以为你永远不会开口呢！
我早就想大干一场了。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
All you have to do is collect energy that naturally gathers around the remnants of robots and machines.
I need 10 bottles every day.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
你只需要收集自然聚集在机器人和机器残骸周围的能量。
我每天需要10瓶。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Come back tomorrow.
Well, you might as well come back every day at this time.
You can't say no.
I need you.
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
明天再来。
嗯，既然这样，你最好每天都这个时间来。
你不能拒绝。
我需要你。

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
Are you dense?
That means I want to be left alone!
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
你是笨蛋吗？
我的意思是我想一个人待着！

scripts.text:
[Lloyd]
I'll need more bottles of the energy.
How are you?
Are you ready to take one for the team?
scripts.translation:
[劳埃德]
我还需要更多瓶装的<死亡骑士>能量。
你还好吗？
准备好为团队牺牲一下了吗？

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你携带的物品过多，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: You don't have to collect more energy at this moment.
scripts.translation: 目前不需要收集更多能量。

scripts.text: You have enough ^4d4dffCondensed Energy^000000.
scripts.translation: 您拥有足够的^4d4dff浓缩能量^000000。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffEmpty Bottle^000000 is required to collect Condensed Energy.
scripts.translation: 收集浓缩能量需要^4d4dff空瓶^000000。

scripts.text:
A thick cloud of energy is visible between the broken pieces of metal.
Bring an empty bottle close to the waving edges of the cloud to collect the energy.
scripts.translation:
在破碎的金属之间可以看到一团浓厚的能量。
将空瓶靠近能量云波动的边缘即可收集能量。

scripts.text: Collected Condensed Energy!
scripts.translation: 已收集浓缩能量！

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Are you heading for Phantasmagorika?
It may be difficult to find. Let me give you some directions.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
你要去幻影迷宫吗？
那里可能很难找。让我给你指指路。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Follow the road all the way up, and then head southwest.
Let me mark the location on your mini-map.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
沿着路一直往上走，然后向西南方向前进。
让我在你的小地图上标记一下位置。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
This place is fraught with formidable monsters, just like the other parts of the old Juperos.
Be safe in your travels.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
这个地方到处都是强大的魔物，就像旧朱佩罗斯的其他地方一样。
祝你旅途平安。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Are you heading for Phantasmagorika?
It may be difficult to find. Let me give you some directions.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
你要去幻影迷宫吗？
那里可能很难找。让我给你指指路。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Go straight east, then follow the road south. You'll see a giant status at a corner.
Let me mark the location on your mini-map.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
一直向东走，然后沿着路向南走。你会在拐角处看到一座巨大的雕像。
让我在你的小地图上标记一下位置。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Who knew there's a hidden place behind a statue? It was pure luck that we found it.
The road to the place is dangerous. Please have safe travel.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
谁能想到雕像后面还藏着一个地方？我们找到它纯属运气。
去那里的路很危险。请小心旅途。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Are you a participant of the Phantasmagorika project?
This is the entrance to the newly discovered ruins in the east.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
你是幻影迷宫项目的参与者吗？
这是新发现的东部遗迹的入口。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
There's a guide on the other side of the entrance to guide you to the excavation site.
Please get in before some monsters pounce on you.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
入口的另一边有一位向导，会带你去挖掘现场。
请快点进去，免得被魔物袭击。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Oh, the other side of the entrance is teeming with aggressive robots.
You'd better brace yourself.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
哦，入口的另一边全是好斗的机器人。
你最好做好心理准备。

scripts.text:
[Excavator Guide]
Are you a participant of the Phantasmagorika project?
As you know, you're at the entrance to Juperos.
scripts.translation:
[挖掘向导]
你是幻影迷宫项目的参与者吗？
如你所知，你现在位于朱佩罗斯的入口。

scripts.text:
[Excavator Guide]
I'm here to guide you to the excavation site connected to the inside of Juperos.
scripts.translation:
[挖掘向导]
我负责引导你前往与朱佩罗斯内部相连的挖掘现场。

scripts.text:
[Excavator Guide]
There are more guides spread across the inside,
so you can find them easily in case you get lost.
scripts.translation:
[挖掘向导]
内部各处都分布着其他向导，
如果你迷路了，很容易就能找到他们。

scripts.text:
[Excavator Guide]
Thank you for your contribution to the development of mankind. Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[挖掘向导]
感谢你对人类发展的贡献。祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Are you a member of the Excavation Group?
Our chairman has personally ordered us to see to your safety so that you can focus on your excavation work.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
你是挖掘小组的成员吗？
会长亲自下令，要求我们确保你的安全，以便你专心进行挖掘工作。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
We're here to support your excavation of Verus City.
Let us know if you experience any problems.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
我们在此支持你对维鲁斯城的挖掘工作。
如果遇到问题，请随时告知我们。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
I hate using portable johns, but my bladder can't seem to hold very much. What about you?
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
我讨厌用移动厕所，但我的膀胱似乎存不住多少水。你呢？

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Ack! Shoo! Don't come close! I'm saving myself for my future bride!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
啊！走开！别靠近我！我要把精力留给未来的新娘！

scripts.text:
[Geologist]
Hm, the building was crushed by the stone wall.
The rest is almost pulverized to dust.
scripts.translation:
[地质学家]
嗯，这座建筑被石墙压垮了。
其余部分几乎被碾成了粉末。

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Yes, Professor.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
是的，教授。

scripts.text:
[Geologist]
The terrain on which the village stands was formed in a different period, compared to this stone wall. At least that's my initial assessment.
scripts.translation:
[地质学家]
村庄所在的地形形成于不同的时期，与这堵石墙不同。至少这是我的初步评估。

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Yes, Professor.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
是的，教授。

scripts.text:
[Geologist]
The underground village doesn't seem to be artificial, though I can't imagine how it can be formed naturally. What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[地质学家]
这个地下村庄似乎不是人工建造的，但我无法想象它是如何自然形成的。你怎么看？

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Yes, Professor.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
是的，教授。

scripts.text:
[Geologist]
...Are you even listening to me?
scripts.translation:
[地质学家]
...你甚至没有在听我说话吗？

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Yes, Professor.
scripts.translation:
[助手]
是的，教授。

scripts.text:
[Geologist]
Sigh.
Let's go have lunch.
scripts.translation:
[地质学家]
叹气。
我们去吃午饭吧。

scripts.text:
[Assistant]
Yes, Professor!
scripts.translation:
[助手]
好的，教授！

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Schwarzwald may be the most scientifically advanced among the three states of Midgard, but it still doesn't hold a candle to this place.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德可能是米德加尔特三个国家中科学最先进的，但在这里面前仍相形见绌。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
The same goes for Juperos. If the scientific knowledge of this place passed down to Schwarzwald, it could have been much more powerful.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
朱佩罗斯也是如此。如果这个地方的科学知识能传承给修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德，它本可以更加强大。

scripts.text:
[Scholar]
Of course, that's based on my theory that the residents of this place were also Schwarzwaldians.
scripts.translation:
[学者]
当然，这是基于我的理论，即这里的居民也是修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德人。

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
I feel like I'm going insane, stuck in this confined space.
Hey, how about I read your fortune for the day with my juggling balls?
scripts.translation:
[皮埃罗]
被困在这个狭小的空间里，我感觉自己快要疯了。
嘿，要不要我用杂耍球为你算算今天的运势？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
Good, choose a color you like.
The color you choose will tell me your fortune.
scripts.translation:
[皮埃罗]
很好，选一个你喜欢的颜色。
你选择的颜色会告诉我你的运势。

scripts.text: Red
scripts.translation: 红色

scripts.text: Blue
scripts.translation: 蓝色

scripts.text: Yellow
scripts.translation: 黄色

scripts.text: Green
scripts.translation: 绿色

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
Dum, dum, dum! Your fortune for the day!
Let's me get the fortune paper inside the ball...
scripts.translation:
[皮埃罗]
咚，咚，咚！来看看你今天的运势吧！
让我看看水晶球里的运势纸条...

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
Today is...
scripts.translation:
[皮埃罗]
今天是...

scripts.text: [Pierrot]
scripts.translation: [皮埃罗]

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
The same boring day, like yesterday and the day before.
Only positive thinking will get you out of this funk. Smile and be nice to others, and maybe Lady Luck will brighten your day.
scripts.translation:
[皮埃罗]
和昨天、前天一样，又是无聊的一天。
只有积极的心态才能让你摆脱这种低迷。保持微笑，善待他人，也许幸运女神会照亮你的一天。

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
Ack, you shouldn't have gotten out of bed. Wherever you go, trouble follows.
I strongly recommend you stay at the Shelter for the day. Sleep off bad luck.
scripts.translation:
[皮埃罗]
哎呀，你就不该起床。无论你去哪里，麻烦都会跟着你。
我强烈建议你今天待在避难所里。睡一觉，把坏运气都甩掉。

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
Not a bad day, but you'll have to work to enjoy some good luck.
Go to the Excavation Site and dig up some dirt. You may find some treasure.
scripts.translation:
[皮埃罗]
今天还不错，但你需要付出努力才能获得好运。
去挖掘点吧，挖点土。也许你能找到一些宝藏。

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
The luckiest day of your life! Wherever you go, you'll find wealth and friends.
Maybe you'll find some historic artifacts buried in this place. That'll be awesome, huh?
scripts.translation:
[皮埃罗]
你一生中最幸运的一天！无论你去哪里，都会发现财富和朋友。
也许你会在这个地方发现一些埋藏的历史文物。那一定很酷，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
Do you like my reading? Or do you hate it?
Your future is pliable--you can shape it however you want.
Don't get too excited or depressed. Just stay focused on your goal.
scripts.translation:
[皮埃罗]
你喜欢我的占卜吗？还是讨厌它？
你的未来是可塑的——你可以随心所欲地塑造它。
不要过于兴奋或沮丧。只要专注于你的目标。

scripts.text:
[Pierrot]
All right, come back if you want another reading.
scripts.translation:
[皮埃罗]
好的，如果你想再占卜一次，随时回来。

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
The owner of this house must have been an important figure in Verus City.
Piles of official documents are discovered in this room.
scripts.translation:
[挖掘者]
这栋房子的主人一定是维鲁斯城的重要人物。
在这个房间里发现了成堆的官方文件。

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
Most of the documents contain petty civil complaints, like water problems and neighbor disputes.
All the documents, however, contain the initials, OX. I don't know if they're of a name or an abbreviation of some sort.
scripts.translation:
[挖掘者]
大多数文件都是琐碎的民事投诉，比如供水问题和邻里纠纷。
然而，所有文件上都印有“OX”的首字母。我不知道这是一个名字，还是某种缩写。

scripts.text: - The building entrance shows distinctive wear and tear, indicating abuse by a steady stream of traffic. YHT and DO NOT YELL are written on the door. -
scripts.translation: - 建筑入口处显示出明显的磨损痕迹，表明有持续的人流经过。门上写着“YHT”和“DO NOT YELL”。-

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
This building is fully furnished, yet there is no sign of habitation.
Maybe the owner lived somewhere else, like in a summer house or something.
scripts.translation:
[挖掘者]
这栋房子设施齐全，却没有居住过的迹象。
也许主人住在别处，比如夏屋之类的地方。

scripts.text: - ZERT... is written on the door. The rest of the writing looks like it was scratched off with a stone.-
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“ZERT...”。剩下的字迹看起来像是被石头刮掉的。-

scripts.text: - +1 is written on the door. What could it mean? -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“+1”。这可能意味着什么？-

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
The owner of this house must have been a dancer. Her wardrobe is full of glittery stage clothes.
Judging by their size, she must have been very tall for a woman. I wonder how she looked like.
scripts.translation:
[挖掘者]
这栋房子的主人一定是一位舞娘。她的衣橱里塞满了闪闪发光的舞台服装。
从尺寸来看，她对于女性来说一定很高。我想知道她长什么样子。

scripts.text: - KDY is written on the door. Sooty streaks that spread outward from the inside to the entrance indicate frequent explosions. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“KDY”。从室内向入口延伸的烟熏痕迹表明这里经常发生爆炸。-

scripts.text: - KJH is written on the door. The entrance wall is dotted with tiny squares of paper containing time and numbers. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“KJH”。入口处的墙壁上点缀着许多写有时间与数字的小纸片。-

scripts.text: - PKY is written on the door. Empty liquor bottles are littered around the house. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“PKY”。屋子里散落着许多空酒瓶。-

scripts.text: - DGDG'S BOARD is written on the door. What does that mean? -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“DGDG'S BOARD”。这是什么意思？-

scripts.text: - THE SUNS is written on the door. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“THE SUNS”。-

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
*Cough Cough* The owner of this house was a hoarder.
Lots of books. Lots of cat furballs. Lots of Assassin pictures. *Cough Cough*
scripts.translation:
[挖掘者]
*咳咳* 这栋房子的主人是个囤积癖。
很多书。很多猫毛球。很多刺客的照片。*咳咳*

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
This house is full of red mushrooms. Are they edible? Why are they only found inside this house? Was the owner farming them?
scripts.translation:
[挖掘者]
这栋房子里长满了红菇。它们能吃吗？为什么只有这栋房子里有？主人是在种植它们吗？

scripts.text: - MARES is written on the door, along with various drawings that seem to symbolize pirates. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“MARES”，旁边还有各种象征海盗的图案。-

scripts.text: - LMH is written on the door, along with a flurry of hearts drawn on an edge. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“LMH”，边缘处画满了爱心。-

scripts.text: - MISA is written on the door. Various toy weapons are littered around the building. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“MISA”。建筑物周围散落着各种玩具武器。-

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
...

[Excavator]
Various pictures are found in this house, all of them featuring the owner with different men.
I find that curious.
scripts.translation:
[挖掘者]
这栋房子里有很多照片，每一张都是主人和不同的男人在一起。
我觉得这很奇怪。

scripts.text: - ELTOHC is written on the door. In the center of the door is a W drawn in a circle. It could have been the owner's favorite letter. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“ELTOHC”。门的中央画着一个圆圈，里面写着W。这可能是主人最喜欢的字母。-

scripts.text: - LEONA'S BIRD HEAVEN is written on the door. Unsurprisingly, bird feathers are littered around the house. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“LEONA'S BIRD HEAVEN”。不出所料，屋子里散落着许多羽毛。-

scripts.text: - KURAT is written on the door. The building wall is littered with hand-drawn skulls. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“KURAT”。墙壁上画满了手绘的骷髅头。-

scripts.text: - KSY is written on the door. A poster with The Performance of the Century! boldly printed across it is hung on the entrance wall. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“KSY”。入口处的墙上挂着一张海报，上面醒目地印着“世纪演出！”。-

scripts.text: - BIBIC & MORZIP'S LOVE HOUSE is written on the door. A couple must have lived in this house. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“BIBIC & MORZIP'S LOVE HOUSE”。一定有一对情侣住在这栋房子里。-

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
The owner of this house must have been a collector of some sort. There are many pictures of women in strange-looking dresses.
scripts.translation:
[挖掘者]
这栋房子的主人一定是某种收藏家。有很多穿着奇怪裙子的女人的照片。

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
Did you see the SKM drawn on the door? That reminds me of the other house with hearts drawn on its door.
I hope it's not one of those childish customs. You know, to mark someone as theirs.
scripts.translation:
[挖掘者]
你看到门上画的SKM了吗？这让我想起另一栋门上画着爱心的房子。
希望那不是那种幼稚的习俗。你知道的，就是标记某人是自己的那种。

scripts.text: - HDY is written on the door. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“HDY”。-

scripts.text: - BRAN is written on the door. Rows of empty bottles are standing on a side of the house. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“BRAN”。房子的一侧整齐地排列着一排排空瓶。-

scripts.text: - KYH is written on the door. This building is in better condition than the rest in the neighborhood.-
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“KYH”。这栋建筑比周围其他的房子状况要好。-

scripts.text: - YAOB is written on the door, along with drawings of round, furry animals. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“YAOB”，旁边还有圆滚滚、毛茸茸的动物图案。-

scripts.text:
[Excavator]
This house is suspected to belong to a couple named SSUL and SINYC.
The house is filled with incredible things. Everything in it is just gorgeous.
scripts.translation:
[挖掘者]
这栋房子据信属于一对名叫SSUL和SINYC的情侣。
房子里充满了不可思议的东西。里面的每一件东西都非常华丽。

scripts.text: - LMS is written on the door, along with Composition Specialist on an edge. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“LMS”，边缘处还写着“作曲专家”。-

scripts.text: - KJK is written on the door. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“KJK”。-

scripts.text: - LJH is written on the door. The building wall is covered with numerous grocery store stickers. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“LJH”。建筑墙壁上贴满了各种杂货店的贴纸。-

scripts.text: - YG is written on the door. A large picture of a smiling baby is visible through a window. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“YG”。透过窗户可以看到一张微笑婴儿的大幅照片。-

scripts.text: - CHJ is written on the door. -
scripts.translation: - 门上写着“CHJ”。-

scripts.text:
[Archaeologist]
Sometimes, we gather around to talk.
Sharing information is a part of the job.
scripts.translation:
[考古学家]
有时候，我们会聚在一起聊天。
分享信息也是工作的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Historian]
What's the hardest thing about my job?
When I'm forced to eat a terrible lunch provided by my sponsor.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
我工作中最难的是什么？
就是被迫吃赞助方提供的难以下咽的午餐。

scripts.text:
[Historian]
In fact, it's been that way since I arrived in Verus City.
Today was not an exception.
scripts.translation:
[历史学家]
事实上，自从我来到维鲁斯城以来，情况一直如此。
今天也不例外。

scripts.text:
[New Excavator]
I have a lot to learn, and I'm a fast learner.
For now, I'm doing mostly physical tasks.
scripts.translation:
[新来的挖掘者]
我还有很多要学的，而且我学得很快。
目前，我主要做一些体力活。

scripts.text:
[New Excavator]
I'm given free food, a place to sleep, and money. What else can I ask for?
scripts.translation:
[新来的挖掘者]
我有免费的食物、睡觉的地方，还有钱。我还能要求什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Civilization Researcher]
I thought this was a part of Juperos.
I'm now reconsidering that theory.
scripts.translation:
[文明研究员]
我原本以为这是朱佩洛斯的一部分。
现在我正在重新考虑这个理论。

scripts.text:
[Civilization Researcher]
Verus is similar to Juperos, yet different.
Everything about it is more refined and sophisticated somehow.
scripts.translation:
[文明研究员]
维鲁斯与朱佩洛斯相似，却又不同。
这里的每一样东西都显得更加精致和考究。

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
This city's level of mechanical engineering is astonishing.
There's no trace of magic.
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
这座城市的机械工程水平令人惊叹。
这里没有任何魔法的痕迹。

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
But I'm concerned:
rapid development and sudden introduction of advanced technology could do more harm than good.
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
但我有些担忧：
快速的发展和先进技术的突然引入，可能会弊大于利。

scripts.text:
^FF0000- Caution -
- For your safety, -
- avoid running -
- or jumping -
- while inside. -^000000
scripts.translation:
^FF0000- 注意 -
- 为了您的安全， -
- 请勿在室内 -
- 奔跑 -
- 或跳跃。 -^000000

scripts.text:
[Merchant]
Ho ho ho!
I came first, so I took the best spot!
scripts.translation:
[商人]
呵呵呵！
我来得早，所以占了最好的位置！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer ?]
*Stomach rumbles*
Aww, I'm hungry...
scripts.translation:
[冒险者？]
*肚子咕咕叫*
哎呀，我饿了...

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
But I have no money to buy food...
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
但我没钱买食物...

scripts.text:
[Jean Baljean]
Ugh, I was struck 19 times for a piece of bread.
scripts.translation:
[让·巴尔让]
唉，为了买一块面包，我被打了19次。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Mushrooms growing out of rocks.
How resilient!
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
从岩石里长出的蘑菇。
生命力真顽强！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Argh!
So many paths are blocked!
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
啊！
这么多路都被堵住了！

scripts.text:
[Cow]
*Moo*
scripts.translation:
[奶牛]
*哞*

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Heh. *Drool*
This place is incredible!
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
嘿。*流口水*
这地方太棒了！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
This site is amazing.
No wonder why Rekenber called dibs on it.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
这地方真不错。
难怪雷肯贝尔会先占下这里。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
I want to find something awesome!
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
我想找到点厉害的东西！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
The coming era will be yours.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
未来的时代将属于你。

scripts.text:
[Warning]
Attention visitors of Phantasmagorika,
scripts.translation:
[警告]
致幻魔卡（Phantasmagorika）的访客们：

scripts.text:
[Warning]
a cult group called the Doom Prayers has been frequently sighted in this area.
scripts.translation:
[警告]
名为“末日祈祷团”的邪教组织频繁出现在此区域。

scripts.text:
[Warning]
If you're a victim or a witness to the group's harassment, please report to the Phantasmagorika Police.
- Phantasmagorika Police Chief -
scripts.translation:
[警告]
如果您是该组织的受害者或目击者，请向幻魔卡警方报案。
- 幻魔卡警长 -

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Cat]
I must investi... ga... te...
Zzz... Zzz...

[Adventurer Cat]
*Purr*
*Meow*
scripts.translation:
[冒险猫]
*呼噜*
*喵*

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Cat]
For some reason, I can't stand up.
*Meow*
scripts.translation:
[冒险猫]
不知道为什么，我站不起来了。
*喵*

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Cat]
I've got a good spot.
*Purr*
scripts.translation:
[冒险猫]
我找到了个好地方。
*呼噜*

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Ah!
I want to see!
Why can't I go in?!
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
啊！
我想进去看看！
为什么进不去？！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
All right!
This time, I'm going to write a report on a field trip to Phantasmagorika.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
好吧！
这次我要写一篇关于幻魔卡实地考察的报告。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Professor Jones will be so impressed he'll give me A+. *Chuckle*
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
琼斯教授一定会很 impressed，给我打A+的。*轻笑*

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Toh!
Sound mind, sound body!
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
托！
身心强健！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
I'd better pack enough potions for the trip to Phantasmagorika.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
去幻魔卡旅行，我得备足药水。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
I'm impressed by Rekenber's support.
Um...
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
雷肯贝尔的支持让我很感动。
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Merchant]
Ooooh!
I've found a perfect spot for my business!
scripts.translation:
[商人]
哦哦！
我找到了做生意的完美地点！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Elevator? The scientific advancement of Schwarzwald is astonishing!
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
电梯？修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德的科技水平真是令人惊叹！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
An ancient civilization. Doesn't that sound incredible?
I feel like I can hear ancient machines moving with loud clanking noises.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
古代文明。这听起来不可思议吗？
我仿佛能听到古老的机器发出巨大的咔哒声在运转。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
*Dreamy eyes*
*Gaping mouth*
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
*眼神迷离*
*目瞪口呆*

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Geez, this place is already crammed!
Just looking at these people makes me tired.
scripts.translation:
[冒险者]
天哪，这里已经挤满了人！
光是看着这些人我就累了。

scripts.text:
[Elisha]
It was working fine just a moment ago.
I'm sorry.
I'll have to call in a technician. Please use the stairs instead.
scripts.translation:
[伊莱莎]
刚才还好好的。
抱歉。
我得叫个技术人员来。请改用楼梯吧。

scripts.text:
[Elisha]
^0000FFPhantasmagorika is past the tunnel to the south from the southeast gate outside Juperos Ruins.^000000
scripts.translation:
[伊莱莎]
^0000FF幻魔卡位于朱佩罗斯遗迹东南门外的隧道南侧。^000000

scripts.text:
[Elisha]
There are elevator doors near the fountain in the center of the place. Could you check what happened to the elevator?
scripts.translation:
[伊莱莎]
广场中央喷泉附近就有电梯门。你能去看看电梯出了什么问题吗？

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest -
scripts.translation: - 你携带的物品过多，无法继续任务 -

scripts.text: - Someone died! -
scripts.translation: - 有人死了！ -

scripts.text: - Unfortunately, the person who died stuck in the elevator door, and the elevator that opened and closed constantly stuck to him.. -
scripts.translation: - 不幸的是，死者卡在了电梯门里，而不断开合的电梯将他卡住了... -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you ok?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你还好吗？

scripts.text:
[Fallen Man]
......

[{0}]
Can you hear me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你听得见我说话吗？

scripts.text:
[Fallen Man]
...Leave me alone...
scripts.translation:
[倒下的男子]
...别管我了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What?

[Fallen Man]
I am fine, let me go..
scripts.translation:
[倒下的男子]
我没事，放我走...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But you don't look like it's nothing...
Wait here,
I will help you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但你看起来并不像没事的样子...
留在这里，
我来帮你。

scripts.text:
[Fallen Man]
Just telling you that I dont... Hey! My waist!!!
scripts.translation:
[倒下的男子]
我只是想告诉你我不...嘿！我的腰！！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will help you find a doctor!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我会帮你找医生的！

scripts.text:
[Fallen Man]
Excuse me, thank you.
scripts.translation:
[倒下的男子]
抱歉，谢谢。

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest -
scripts.translation: - 你携带的物品过多，无法继续任务 -

scripts.text: later, the boys lying on the stretcher were embarrassed and suddenly grabbed my hand..
scripts.translation: 后来，躺在担架上的男孩感到尴尬，突然抓住了我的手...

scripts.text: Later, the boy lying on the stretcher looked embarrassed and suddenly put a small fruit in my hand..
scripts.translation: 后来，躺在担架上的男孩显得局促不安，突然往我手里塞了一个小水果...

scripts.text:
[Elisha]
Weird!! How can the elevator suddenly move again?
maybe the following people have something to do?
scripts.translation:
[伊莱莎]
奇怪！！电梯怎么突然又动了？
难道跟下面那些人有关？

scripts.text:
[Elisha]
My company Rekenber is in partnership with the Eden Group
for the ^0000FFPhantasmagorika excavation project^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊莱莎]
我的公司Rekenber正与乐园团
合作进行^0000FF幻影迷宫的发掘项目^000000。

scripts.text:
[Elisha]
The newly discovered legacy of the ancients: Phantasmagorika!
Contact the ^0000FFEden Group^000000 to join its Phantasmagorika excavation project!
scripts.translation:
[伊莱莎]
新发现的古代遗迹：幻影迷宫！
请联系^0000FF乐园团^000000加入幻影迷宫的发掘项目！

scripts.text:
[Elisha]
Good day.
Please say your name, so I can check your registration.
scripts.translation:
[伊莱莎]
您好。
请报上您的名字，以便我核对您的登记信息。

scripts.text: Say your name.
scripts.translation: 报上名字

scripts.text: Ask about the registration.
scripts.translation: 询问登记情况

scripts.text: End conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Elisha]
Um, let's see...
I'm sorry, but you're not on the list. Could you check your registration status?
scripts.translation:
[伊莱莎]
嗯，让我看看...
抱歉，名单上没有您。请确认一下您的登记状态？

scripts.text:
[Elisha]
You're back already.
scripts.translation:
[伊莱莎]
您这么快就回来了。

scripts.text:
[Elisha]
It was working fine just a moment ago.
I'm sorry.
I'll have to call in a technician. Please use the stairs instead.
scripts.translation:
[伊莱莎]
刚才还好好的。
抱歉。
我得叫个技术人员来。请改用楼梯吧。

scripts.text:
[Elisha]
I'm sorry.
The elevator is currently out of order.
scripts.translation:
[伊莱莎]
抱歉。
电梯目前故障无法使用。

scripts.text:
[Elisha]
God! How come again!!!
This bad elevator is always broken! Everyday!!!
scripts.translation:
[伊莱莎]
天哪！怎么又坏了！！！
这部破电梯总是坏！天天都这样！！！

scripts.text:
[Elisha]
Let's see...
A... B... C... D... E... F... Ah, there it is!
scripts.translation:
[伊莱莎]
让我看看...
A... B... C... D... E... F... 啊，找到了！

scripts.text:
[Elisha]
Let's see...
Ah, I've found your name.
Would you like to ^0000FFmove to Phantasmagorika^000000 now?
scripts.translation:
[伊莱莎]
让我看看...
啊，找到您的名字了。
您现在想要^0000FF前往幻影迷宫^000000吗？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Elisha]
Have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[伊莱莎]
祝您度过愉快的一天。

scripts.text:
[Elisha]
Let me send you to Phantasmagorika.
scripts.translation:
[伊莱莎]
让我送您去幻影迷宫。

scripts.text:
[Elisha]
For your safety, please avoid running or jumping while inside.
scripts.translation:
[伊莱莎]
为了您的安全，请在内部避免奔跑或跳跃。

scripts.text:
[Elisha]
Ready?
Have a safe exploration!
scripts.translation:
[伊莱莎]
准备好了吗？
祝您探索顺利！

scripts.text:
^FF0000- BEEP-! -
- Service temporarily unavailable. -^000000

[Elisha]
Um?
Could you hold on a moment?
scripts.translation:
[伊莱莎]
嗯？
请稍等一下好吗？

scripts.text:
^FF0000- BEEP-! -
- Service temporarily unavailable. -^000000

[Elisha]
Um...
What's wrong with it?
Please give me a moment.
scripts.translation:
[伊莱莎]
嗯...
它怎么了？
请给我一点时间。

scripts.text:
^FF0000- BEEP-! -
- Service temporarily unavailable. -^000000

[Elisha]
Uh-oh.
Is it out of order?
It can't be!
scripts.translation:

Heya!
What brings you here, sweetheart?

嗨！
有什么事吗，亲爱的？
如果你想找个肩膀哭一场，我就在这里。

[Leitner]
I know, I know; why the extra step when the elevator is open to the public?
scripts.translation:
[莱特纳]
我知道，我知道；既然电梯对公众开放，为什么还要多这一步呢？

scripts.text:
[Leitner]
The elevator breaks almost every day, probably from carrying too many people.
Ah, I need rest. Sigh.
scripts.translation:
[莱特纳]
电梯几乎每天都坏，大概是载了太多人吧。
啊，我需要休息。叹气。

Oh.
I should have known.
You mean the elevator to Phantasmagorika, eh?
scripts.translation:
[莱特纳]
哦。
我早该想到的。
你是说去幻影魔境的那部电梯，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Leitner]
When I first got this job, the elevator was private and I did diddly-squat.
scripts.translation:
[莱特纳]
我刚接手这份工作的时候，电梯是私人的，我几乎什么都不用做。

[Leitner]
Then, the management opened it to the public and my life went straight to hell.
scripts.translation:
[莱特纳]
后来，管理层把它对公众开放了，我的生活简直变成了地狱。

[Leitner]
Ah, why me?!
Goodbye, peaceful days!
I'm so busy that I barely have time for the ladies.
scripts.translation:
[莱特纳]
啊，为什么是我？！
再见了，平静的日子！
我忙得连陪女士们的时间都没有了。

scripts.translation:

总之，让我们先把你登记好。我想赶紧回去休息。
呃...在这里写下你的名字，然后在旁边按个指纹。
好了。很简单吧？

you!

你带老旧铁板来了吗？

Take my hand and get down.

[杜]
谢天谢地！
来，玛姬！
抓住我的手，下来。

幸好没人受伤。

太棒了！

nothing is going in my favor!

怎么什么都不顺利！

Look, I wiped it, and it sparkles!

Why can't you just listen to us?
scripts.translation:

你为什么就不能听我们说话呢？

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Stop wasting your time on something so stupid!
scripts.translation:

别在这种无聊的事情上浪费时间了！

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Um...
Wait.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
嗯...
等等。

scripts.text:
[Alph]
Look, it doesn't look like it's been buried deep underground for centuries.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
你看，它看起来并不像是在地下埋藏了几个世纪的样子。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
You're right. It looks too clean underneath all the dirt and grime.
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]

scripts.text:

Let's see...
scripts.translation:

让我看看...

scripts.text:

Um...

scripts.translation:

嗯...
太干净了。我看不出任何线索。

scripts.text:
[Alph]
If this fountain was ever used, it should have some sort of deposit left on the bottom, but there's none at all. It's almost as if the water was drained out of it at once.

如果这个喷泉曾经被使用过，底部应该会有某种沉积物，但这里一点都没有。就好像水被一次性排干了一样。

scripts.text:
[Alph]
The deposit could have been wiped off naturally after a long time.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
沉积物可能在漫长的时间里自然消失了。

scripts.text:

我们找找别的东西吧。

scripts.translation:

嗯...
一切都太干净了。
这个遗址看起来不像我们以为的那么古老。

scripts.translation:
[杜]
我进来后就一直在想：树不是需要阳光才能生长吗？

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

而且我才不会让别人抢走所有的宝物！

有一条向上的路。

Grr!

我以为这里会和上一个地方一样，结果到处都是机器。

scripts.translation:

这些和朱佩罗斯的那些是一样的吗？

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

This place is disturbingly clean.

这里干净得让人不安。

All the buildings are well preserved. What do you think happened to the owners?
scripts.translation:
[塔马林]
所有的建筑都保存得很完好。你觉得主人去哪了？

If they're dead, they're not buried or left to rot in here. If they left... well, I don't think they did.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔夫]
如果他们死了，这里没有尸体，也没有腐烂的痕迹。如果他们离开了...我不觉得他们离开了。

scripts.text:

I tried to read with magic,
but to no avail.
scripts.translation:
[玛姬]
我试着用魔法读取信息，

scripts.text:

So the trail of clues went cold.
scripts.translation:
[杜]
看来线索断了。

[杜]
哎哟！你干嘛打我？

Unlike the first place, this place is filled with giant machines.

[马克]
你看到前面的巨型机器了吗？
和第一个地方不同，这里到处都是巨型机器。

Buildings are crumbled. The ground is caved in here and there.
scripts.translation:
[马克]
建筑已经坍塌，地面这里那里都塌陷了。

scripts.text:

I've found a path over there, though it's blocked.
scripts.translation:
[马克]
我在那边发现了一条路，不过被堵住了。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
That doesn't bode well.
scripts.translation:
[马克]
这可不是好兆头。

scripts.text:

Oh, Tamarin!
Don't go over there!

哦，塔马林！

scripts.translation:
[玛姬]
哦。
这边的路也被堵住了。

but I can't tell exactly what.
scripts.translation:
[玛姬]
我感觉到那边有一股气流，
但具体是什么还说不清楚。

scripts.text:

It doesn't feel like a living thing,
but it's strong just the same.
scripts.translation:
[玛姬]
感觉不像是有生命的东西，
但力量依然很强。

scripts.text:
[Du]
Um.
I really don't want to go over there.
scripts.translation:
[杜]
嗯。
我真的不想去那边。

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

No one calls me that!
scripts.translation:
[杜]
没人这么叫我！

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

我有更酷的绰号！叫那个！

Du.
